title: Strictify a comparison after a fully faithful inclusion
statement: Let A,B,D be categories, F:A→B, J:B→D fully faithful, G:A→D, e:FJ≅G a specified natural isomorphism, and h_X:J(FX)=GX specified object equalities. Define α_X to be the unique preimage under J of e_X followed by eqToIso(h_X) inverse. Then copyObj(F,F.obj,α) followed by J equals G strictly. This construction preserves all source object representatives and uses the explicit fully faithful preimage construction.

source.place: Construction 5.25, pp. 36-37; agent-expanded normalization and conjugation calculations using Mathlib/CategoryTheory/NatIso.lean (copyObj, isoCopyObj), EqToHom.lean (Functor.ext), and Functor/FullyFaithful.lean (preimageIso).

proof.text: The composite e_X;eqToIso(h_X) inverse is an automorphism of J(FX). Take its fully faithful preimage, yielding an automorphism α_X of FX. This is comparisonNormalizer.
Mathlib copyObj has the same objects as F and sends f:X→Y to α_X inverse;F(f);α_Y. Applying J and using the preimage equations yields eqToHom(h_X);e_X inverse;J(Ff);e_Y;eqToHom(h_Y inverse).
Naturality_1 identifies the middle three factors with G(f). Apply Functor.ext with h_X to conclude strict functor equality.

proof_origin.place: Explicit calculation by X5 from the displayed definitions and naturality identities; no law-existence theorem or new unproved statement is invoked.

mathlib_searches.query: A functor can be conjugated by arbitrary object automorphisms and remains naturally isomorphic but its maps may differ
mathlib_searches.results: Functor.copyObj and Functor.isoCopyObj provide exactly the conjugated functor and its comparison; these existing constructions are used directly. The remaining result concerns normalization after a fully faithful inclusion.
mathlib_searches.verdict: Use copyObj and isoCopyObj; no duplicate functor construction is needed.

mathlib_searches.results: NatIso.naturality_2 gives the conjugation identity for an existing natural isomorphism. Naturality_1 is the inverse-direction identity used in the normalization proof.
mathlib_searches.verdict: Use the naturality API; it requires a natural comparison and does not make arbitrary object identifications natural.

mathlib_searches.results: Read Mathlib CategoryTheory/NatIso.lean:239-246, EqToHom.lean:214-222, Functor/FullyFaithful.lean:205-227, and ExceptionalRingTransportCoreData.lean. The data fields contain no support normalization requirement.
mathlib_searches.verdict: Mathlib supplies transport, preimages and extensionality. The strict support requirement is absent from TransportCoreData.

from.place: The fixed-field morphism component: testing and constructing the normalization required for a strict support comparison.

lean.statement: theorem copyObj_comparisonNormalizer_comp {D : Type u₃} [Category.{v₃} D] (J : B ⥤ D) (hJ : J.FullyFaithful) (G : A ⥤ D) (e : F ⋙ J ≅ G) (hobj : ∀ X : A, (F ⋙ J).obj X = G.obj X) : F.copyObj F.obj (F.comparisonNormalizer J hJ G e hobj) ⋙ J = G
